name: Familiar
long_description: Familiar is the Neolab for world translation. Dubbing into 30 languages. Now with Familiar, the same actor's performance is preserved instead of a mismatched voice over a mismatched face. One model does the voice, the lips, and the scene together, with identity permanence and scene & world understanding. Built by the researchers who pioneered joint audio-visual human models.
one_liner: Movies in Every Language. Better than Humans.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Sold voice AI for six figures, built the best human avatar cloning model in the spring, and turned down a large offer to join a voice company as their model-research lead -- to build Familiar. Stanford dropout.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: AI PhD from Yonsei University. Built large-scale text-to-video models at Adobe Research and published at top AI conferences. Previously operated localized YouTube channels with 400K+ total subscribers.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: AI PhD from HKUST, 30+ publications on top-tier AI venues with 2k+ citations and 2k+ github stars.

launches.title: Familiar
launches.tagline: Movies in Every Language. Better than Humans.
launches.body: Familiar is the Neolab for world translation. Dubbing into 30 languages. Something impossible for humans -- now with Familiar, the same actor's performance, preserved instead of a mismatched voice over a mismatched face. One model does the voice, the lips, and the scene together, with identity permanence and 3d understanding; and it matches human translators, published. Built by the researchers who pioneered joint audio-visual human models. thefamiliarlab.com/benchmark
